tasks.label: Run Skill Swap API (local demo DB)
args: import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto'; import { MongoMemoryReplSet } from 'mongodb-memory-server'; const db = await MongoMemoryReplSet.create({ replSet: { count: 1 } }); process.env.NODE_ENV = 'development'; process.env.PORT = '5000'; process.env.CLIENT_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:5173'; process.env.MONGODB_URI = db.getUri('skill_swap'); process.env.JWT_SECRET = randomBytes(48).toString('hex'); try { await import('./backend/src/seed.js'); const { start } = await import('./backend/src/server.js'); await start(); console.info('Skill Swap local demo database is active; data is temporary for this run.'); } catch (error) { await db.stop(); console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; }

tasks.label: Identify API port listener
args: const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process'); const lines = execFileSync('netstat', ['-ano'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).split(/\r?\n/).filter(line => /:5000\s+.*LISTENING/i.test(line)); console.log(lines.join('\n') || 'No process is listening on port 5000'); for (const pid of new Set(lines.map(line => line.trim().split(/\s+/).pop()))) { try { console.log(execFileSync('tasklist', ['/FI', `PID eq ${pid}`, '/FO', 'LIST'], { encoding: 'utf8' })); } catch (error) { console.error(error.message); } }

tasks.label: Identify backend port 5000 process
tasks.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = $($_.OwningProcess)"; [PSCustomObject]@{PID=$_.OwningProcess; Process=$p.Name; CommandLine=$p.CommandLine} } | Format-List
